connection_type.description: Possible values:`SshTunnel`, `PrivateLink` . `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and the following parameter's values are specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`.

host.description: Host IP address. Ignored if `hosts` value is provided.

packing_mode.description: Whether to sync all tables in unpacked mode only or all tables in packed mode only. Default value: `UseUnpackedModeOnly`.

port.description: Port number. Ignored if `hosts` value is provided.

sync_pack_mode.description: Legacy alias for `packing_mode`. Indicates whether synced data will be packed into a single entry(column), or unpacked with one layer of nested fields.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, only specify when connecting via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer). Required for connector creation.

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, only specify when connecting via an SSH tunnel. Required for connector creation.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel. Required for connector creation.

schema_prefix.title: Destination schema prefix
schema_prefix.description: Destination schema prefix. Prefix for each replicated schema. For example with prefix 'x', source schemas 'foo' and 'bar' get replicated as 'x_foo' and 'x_bar'. The prefix is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation
